fact: Shaqodoon says its AI early warning system SAADAAL, which detects early signals of droughts and floods from environmental and climate data, is deployed with Southwest State's Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Disaster Management in real disaster preparedness workflows rather than left as a pilot.

Diginomica reports that the Shaqodoon Organization's AI-enhanced Saadaal early-warning system, rolled out in April 2024, runs weather and historical data through an AI agent to produce reports for the Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Disaster Management in a south-western state, which sends toll-free voice alerts to communities and farmers.
